integrity: The numerical assertions are exact rational consequences of the displayed matrices. Standard LQR sign conventions were checked against independent control references. Search noncoverage is used only as originality evidence, not as a proof of universal novelty.
scientific_limitations: Controller-sign consistency result for the printed linear error model and displayed four-decimal gain only; it does not determine the unprinted sign used in simulation code and does not reassess remote nonlinear dynamics or hardware experiments.
title: The displayed LQR gain selects the opposite sign from the printed Riccati convention
